basics.title: HR Assistant
basics.summary: Driven by the desire to place people at the heart of the company, I offer a comprehensive HR approach, supported by my mastery of labor law and great adaptability. My goal is to commit to your side in a permanent contract (CDI) to support your development, providing daily HR management that is reliable, practical, and attentive to the teams.

bullets: Comprehensive administrative management of training actions: planning, tracking, and updating files.
Steering and coordination of apprenticeships and internships, from integration to administrative follow-up.
Participation in the operational steering of HR activities in line with the company's strategy.
Implementation and management of digital archiving of certificates and training documents.
Rigorous tracking of staff leave, absences, and attendance, in liaison with the manager.
Creation, analysis, and tracking of HR indicators for reporting and decision support.
Collection, entry, and verification of variable pay elements (hours, absences, bonuses, leave).
Processing of individual requests relating to remuneration and social benefits.
Monthly collection, entry, and verification of Variable Pay Elements (EVP).
Tracking of working hours and processing of absences (paid leave, RTT, sick leave).
Management of onboarding formalities: declarations of employment (DPAE) and affiliations (health insurance, provident insurance).
Welcoming and responding to customers by phone, email, and messaging.
Providing clear and precise information on products and services.
Quick management and resolution of customer complaints.
Tracking of customer files and updating databases.
Coordination with internal teams to handle complex requests.
Meeting performance objectives and quality standards.

education.degree: Bachelor in Applied Management for Humanities and Social Sciences
